deviations.description: Cord goal infeasible by a small margin (cord_floor exceeds cord_lim by about 0.3 to 3 Gy). The cord-detector units 4, 6 and 9 have biases of about -0.5, so they only fire once cord_floor exceeds cord_lim by roughly 3 Gy; such requests are sent to automated planning instead of being escalated (when no other rule fires).
deviations.condition: (cord_floor - cord_lim > 0.3) and (cord_floor - cord_lim < 2.5) and (missing == 0) and (cov <= cap) and not ((mand_in_ptv - 0.05 * ptv_vol > 0.1) and (cov > mand_lim))
